content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in the following.

spec.description: Unshaded rectangle; x−2 to the left, x+3 below and 66 cm² inside. No added vertex labels.
spec.mathematics: Area=(x−2)(x+3)=66. Construction ratio 11:6 follows the positive-length solution; numeric lengths are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source expressions and supplied area are visible.

answer.worked:
Using the rectangle's area in $\mathrm{cm}^2$,
$$\begin{align*}(x-2)(x+3)&=66\\x^2+x-6&=66\\x^2+x-72&=0\\(x+9)(x-8)&=0\\x&=-9\text{ or }x=8.\end{align*}$$
Side lengths must be positive, so $x>2$. Hence $x=8$, giving sides $6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $11\,\mathrm{cm}$.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base, apex nearer the right endpoint, dashed vertical altitude, external base and height dimension arrows, and internal area label.
spec.mathematics: Approved model A=(8,8), B=(0,0), C=(12,0), uniformly scaled. Base 12 and altitude 8 satisfy area 48. Apex offset 8 is a drawing choice, not an assessed given. Printed labels remain 2x and x+2.
spec.answerVisibility: No solved lengths, vertex names or value of x appear.

answer.worked:
Using the triangle's area in $\mathrm{cm}^2$,
$$\begin{align*}\frac12(2x)(x+2)&=48\\x^2+2x-48&=0\\(x+8)(x-6)&=0\\x&=-8\text{ or }x=6.\end{align*}$$
The base must be positive, so $x=6$. The base is $12\,\mathrm{cm}$ and the perpendicular height is $8\,\mathrm{cm}$.
